question: total building footprint area m2
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry)) AS total_footprint_area_m2 FROM lisbon_buildings;

question: average building footprint area by class
sql: SELECT class, AVG(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry)) AS avg_footprint_area_m2 FROM lisbon_buildings GROUP BY class ORDER BY avg_footprint_area_m2 DESC;

question: top 10 largest buildings by footprint area
sql: SELECT id, struct_extract(names, 'primary') AS name, class, ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) AS footprint_area_m2 FROM lisbon_buildings ORDER BY footprint_area_m2 DESC LIMIT 10;

question: total road length km by road class
sql: SELECT class, SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry))/1000.0 AS total_length_km FROM lisbon_roads GROUP BY class ORDER BY total_length_km DESC;

question: top 10 longest road segments
sql: SELECT id, struct_extract(names, 'primary') AS name, class, ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry) AS length_m FROM lisbon_roads ORDER BY length_m DESC LIMIT 10;

question: buildings taller than 50m footprint area
sql: SELECT id, struct_extract(names, 'primary') AS name, height, ST_Area(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true)) AS footprint_area_m2 FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE height > 50 ORDER BY footprint_area_m2 DESC;
